column1: # HBM-QQBIND-1 2026-11-12: P1/P2 schedule premises for the 34 qq lanes (delta qq_b10x_1112_r3x 2737efc9dcdb, plan r3xc a072aaeeac6d).
# Method: structural RTL read at main d3f85cdf01 (no sim). Source leaves = bind packing of the t40w bind (hbm-vsn-xtap-t40w/bind/bind_latency.json, same lane ids and word widths as qq).
# P1 = pulses only on slot0 (t0 + kB); P2 = levels change only on slot0. FAIL = a reachable source update/pulse spacing of 1 cycle (not a multiple of B) under the shipped RTL / compiler.
# No source on any lane is gated by a fixed period-2/4 enable; every listed producer steps one programme/calendar row (or one stream element) per edge.
# Source keys: S1 pgp command: ot_hbm_su_programme.sv:343-344 "Subsequent lines every edge", :358-360 pc<=pc+1 per edge
#  S2 VM calendar lg_local_read/write: ot_vms_calendar_static_xcap.sv:66,89-96 one row per edge, host period limit-base (any 1..1024)
#  S3 cic inj_rd/inj_addr: copy of ot_hgi_coll_ctl_v5.sv:246,276; issuer ot_hgi_coll_static_issuer_v5.sv:97,106-112 one uop per edge (1-row loops)
#  S4 hb_coll del_valid/del_flit/hgi_del_obase: ot_hfd_coll_q_hard_v8g.sv:433-434; ot_hgi_coll_ctl_v5.sv:252 per edge, obase steps per loop iteration
#  S5 hc u_q.lg_rq: ot_hbm_hc_q_static.sv:142-143; ot_hgi_hc_residual_vm_static.sv:41-43 fire=active for 320*npos consecutive edges
#  S7 sucore rf_bcmd/rf_bword/rf_dsec: ot_hbm_su_static_qcore_r13.sv:264-266 reload every edge from the pgp read command
#  S8 vmb rr0 (rr_v pulse + rr_d): ot_vms_bank_q0_faces_body.sv:22-24 one read per bank per cycle, :484-486 rr_v<=d_v per edge
#  S9 vmb wq_done0: ot_vms_bank_q0_faces_body.sv:386-387 one write per bank per cycle
#  C1 su bank_read_data (no valid on the lane): ot_hbm_su_static_pinned_bank.sv:44 read_data<=raw_data every edge; su_top_compile.py:145 emit 64 consecutive edges
#  C2 pretree_tree_o: ot_hbm_su_red_pretree.sv:66,102; su_pretree_lower.py:10 "even blocks emitted on consecutive edges"
#  C3 near_rq/near_wq: ot_hbm_vm_lg_static_bank.sv:70-71,97-98; su_top_compile.py:123-127 fill reads every port every edge (1024 edges)
#  C4 u_slice slice_x[32]: ot_hbm_su_static_pgslice_s.sv:386 slice_x<=ro_x[..] every edge
#  C5 cxdl fault: ot_hbm_su_static_cxport_split.sv:107 sticky level rising on any cycle
#  C6 c_rr/c_w_done: ot_hgi_sfu_lg_pair_leaf.sv:36-39 one return per local read (HC residual reader fires every edge; sfu_NE2 qswiglu image bank-4 spacing 1,3)
#  C7 sfucore __cut_ctl arithmetic flop = control: ot_hgi_sfu_static_quarter_sp2.sv:37-39 control<=compiler_control every edge; sfu_vector_calendar.py:60-62
#  C8 sfucore store_a/b cmd0_Q (inferred = store rd_q): ot_hgi_sfu_static_operand_store_sp2.sv:46-49 rd_q<=rd_q_s no enable
#  C9 sfucore lane_rd_re/vm_we/ro_v + addr/data: ot_su12_sfu_sp2.sv:478-487,847-857; sfu_vector_calendar.py:61 emit on consecutive edges

#  A1 hb_idx scorer E-pin regs (e_bus,g_qv,g_q,g_kv,g_kkv,g_key,g_aux): ot_hbm_idx_score_quarter_static_h.sv:21,33-37 reload every clock; key_slot ot_hbm_idx_qctl_static.sv:41; tools/hbm_idx_static_calendar.py:91-93 171 key beats key_period=1 (consecutive)
#  A2 sm u_qs_b_out (rv,rrow,rdata,fault): ot_hbm_accel_smh_attn.sv:190,202 relay every clock; sm_mv_unit.py:15-17,243 8 last-lines on consecutive cycles -> rv back-to-back
#  A3 xq pegress xw_en/xw_grp/xw_data: ot_hgi_sm_xload_static_xql.sv:139-147; ot_hgi_sm_xload_static_cl2.sv:380-389,406 em_on held >= 8 consecutive edges, eb steps per edge
